param: A Recruitment rate of humans (all newborns enter Susceptible)
β Transmission coefficient / probability of successful infection (primary infection term β S I). Table gives range [0.01, 5].
ε Correction parameter for reinfection term (reinfection force ε β R I), 0–1
u Vaccination rate moving Susceptible to Vaccinated, 0–1
θ Vaccine waning rate moving Vaccinated to Susceptible. Table gives range [0.067, 0.1].
γ Recovery rate moving Infected to Recovered. Table gives range [0.5, 2].
δ Waning natural immunity rate moving Recovered to Susceptible. Table gives range [0.003, 0.02].
μ Natural death rate (applies to all compartments). Table indicates estimated ~ 1/(65×12 months); numeric not cleanly extractable from table.
b Dimensionless transmission scaling used in nondimensional system (paper Section 3.2)
m Dimensionless natural death rate used in nondimensional system
c Dimensionless immunity waning rate used in nondimensional system
d Dimensionless vaccine waning rate used in nondimensional system
e Dimensionless reinfection correction parameter used in nondimensional system
ū Dimensionless vaccination rate used in nondimensional system
ℛ_c Control reproduction number as given in the paper (dimensionless form)
K Bifurcation sign quantity (paper uses calligraphic K / script K) determining backward vs forward bifurcation
